carParks.notes:
Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR)

Blue Badge holders: Parking is free for all Blue Badge holders at ANPR car parks. To qualify for free parking, Blue Badge holders will need to register their vehicles on the APCOA Blue Badge portal using this link https://bluebadge.apcoa.co.uk/

When parking, please ensure that your Blue Badge is displayed at all times. If dedicated Blue Badge bays are occupied, please park within any available standard bay and display your Blue Badge

toilets.location:
The toilets are located on the Main Concourse, Platform 2/3, Platform 5 and Platform 6/8. The National key toilets are located on the Main Concourse, Platform 5 and Platform 6/8; these toilets are operated by a radar key. The radar key is available from the Customer Reception upon request. Toilet opening times:

  • Monday to Friday: 05:00 to 22:50
  • Saturday: 05:00 to 22:50
  • Sunday: 07:45 to 23:00

bus.notes:
Most local buses depart from the Sheffield Bus Interchange or the Arundel Gate Interchange, both of which are a short walk from the station. View the map and in a printable format here.

The free-to-ride Sheffield Connect bus service departs from Sheffield Bus Interchange Starnd B1. Find more information about the Sheffield Connect service here.
